text: Sri.G.Sivankutty retired from service as District Registrar General on 30/11/2013 and upon his retirement, the Accountant General(A&E) has issued verification report on 21/03/2014 admitting him DCRG of Rs.7,00,000/-. After a lapse of more that two years from his retirement the Inspector General of Registration issued Liability Certificate of Rs 1,35,34,463/- and withhold his DCRG since the liability exceeded the DCRG. Aggrieved by this, Sri.G.Sivankutty filed OA No.2144/2019 and the Hon'ble KAT vide orders dated 05/12/2019 directed the first respondent to consider and pass orders in the representation furnished by Sri. Sivankutty after affording an opportunity of personal hearing. Based on that the incumbent was heard and Govt vide order referred 2nd above issued orders to release the withheld DCRG to the applicant on finding that the Accountant General has dropped the audit objections from the C&AG report and thereby complied with the orders dated 05/12/2019 of KAT in OA No.2144/2019.

The Accountant General has flagged certain practical difficulties being encountered in the issuance of pay slips to the Gazetted officers attached to short-term projects in Government Departments like Public Works, Irrigation, Co-operation, Land Revenue and State Insurance. At present, no distinct Government Orders or standardized procedures exist to resolve the issues regarding the issuance of payslips to posts in temporary establishments and segregation of posts as Gazetted and Non-Gazetted for identification, to issue payslips to Gazetted posts. Consequently, the Accountant General's office has facing difficulties in implementing relevant provisions in the orders, leading to inconsistencies in decisions.

As per the Government Order read 1<sup>st</sup> above, Government issued detailed guidelines on the procedure of Bill Discounting system (BDS) for making payment of pending bills of contractors. Based on the procedure laid down therein, Government have issued orders fixing the schedule of payment of pending bills up to the month of August 2025 in the Government order read 2<sup>nd</sup> above. In continuation to this, Government are now pleased to sanction the schedule date for issuing LoC for clearing the pending bills in respect of PWD (Roads), PWD (Bridges) and PWD (Buildings & Local Works) for the month of September 2025 as detailed below:
